row.notes: Constructor-style builder for the championship standings view-model (drivers + constructors tables) used by the MP season complete screen; returns self. Allocates the drivers sub-VM (0xf8 bytes, stored self+0x28, allocator +0x20) with VM props local_player, player_pos_idx, teammate_pos_idx, show_side_car_texture, show_team_name, and the constructors sub-VM (0x80 bytes, self+0x38) with local_player_team, player_team_pos; optional tile-list holders at self+0x48 (0x88 bytes) when config+8 / +0x15 / +0x17 flags are set. If session (param_4) is non-null it finds the local entrant in session+0x2e0..0x2e8 (EntrantRecord array), fills driver rows via FUN_141825f30 for standings groups 0/1/2 (session+0x1030 vtable+0x1a0), pads empty rows with a team node ref, then loops the constructors standings (vtable+400 result, +0x150 history) creating tiles session_standings_constructors_table_header_gp_race_f1 / session_standings_constructors_table_pill_gp_race_f1 with index, position, points and points-gap text (Ui_Format_ResourcePointsAmountText) and marks the player team row (team id = entrant team_stat_id >> 16, 0x3fff = none). Good hook point to alter standings rows shown at season end.
